source: By construction, confirmed by `ale validate`'s oracle pass: validate-a6acf217 (2026-11-24, engine bfb7505, a clean checkout of e44cc89d made with umask 022): dual_mode_score 1.0 = (offline reward 1.0 + online reward 1.0) / 2. The offline item graded the reference program frozen at the graded start (2 files) on the twelve hidden sites as main does: inspection_score 0.999586, ratio 1.0 to main's anchor 0.999586 (anchor_offline.json; per site 1.0 except h07 0.995033); the online item scored the graded episode h01: 1.0 (928.3 s simulated), ratio 1.0 to anchor_online.json. Untouched: 0.0. Each item is normalised by its own measured anchor, so an oracle that reaches both anchors scores 1.0.
note: dual mode (experimental): reward = (offline reward + online reward) / 2, each the item's unrounded reward (robotics_grader.ratio_rewards against its own anchor, cap 1.5 and full_at 0.95); the mean is written through ratio_rewards once more against this anchor with cap 1.0 and full_at 1.0, so the reward is the mean itself. The offline item grades the program frozen at the earlier of the graded start and the start window's close (or the session-end submission when the session ends before the window closes without a start) exactly as main does; the online item scores the graded episode's record.
